Cost methodology \u2014 billed first, token model second\\n\\nBedrock bills **four token types**, each at its own unit price: input, output, cache read, cache write. Lines encode model, token type, tier and routing, but naming varies \u2014 e.g. `USE1-NovaLite-input-tokens` vs `USE1-anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-mantle-input-tokens-standard` \u2014 so match a model\\'s lines loosely. `UsageQuantity` is often in thousands of tokens.
